purpose: silver_airports cleans the bronze OurAirports extract (airports carrying an IATA code) into a typed, deduplicated reference table of global airports for geospatial, routing, and lookup consumers.
usage: Join or filter on airport_id, the declared grain; treat continent_code 'NA' and iso_country_code 'NA' as the literal codes for North America and Namibia, never as missing data; coalesce or filter the nullable code columns (icao_code, gps_code, local_code) and the sparsely populated homepage_url, wikipedia_url, municipality, elevation_feet, and keywords columns as your use case requires.
limitations: local_code (63.7% null) and homepage_url (74.9% null) are too sparse to rely on for most rows; keywords (68.0% null) is unstructured free text; elevation_feet (3.7% null) and municipality (4.0% null) are retained nullable rather than imputed; airport_type observed only 5 of the publisher's 7 documented values because this bronze extract is pre-filtered to airports carrying an IATA code, so balloonport and closed_airport records are absent; duplicate_row_rate was 0.0 so no row-level deduplication was needed.
